metadata.name: MedOrbits Document Library
metadata.description: Central registry for MedOrbits public document resources, including checklists, admission guides, fee guides, and other approved downloadable educational resources.
metadata.disclaimer: Documents are informational resources. Users must independently confirm current requirements, eligibility, fees, deadlines, and procedures with the relevant official authority.

categories.title: Checklists Library
categories.description: Printable planning checklists for admissions, applications, education, examinations, career development, general organization, and study abroad.

categories.title: Admission Guides
categories.description: Educational admission guides covering general admissions and programme-specific pathways.

categories.title: Fee Guides
categories.description: Planning guides for education fees, living costs, scholarships, education loans, counselling charges, and refund terms.

requirements: Each category must have a valid README and its own manifest where specified.
Each resource manifest must conform to the applicable JSON schema.
Every published resource must exist at its declared path.
Resource paths must not traverse outside the approved assets/documents directory.
Documents must pass content, privacy, accessibility, and file-quality reviews before publication.
Time-sensitive information must be reviewed against relevant official sources.
Verification claims must be supported by documented evidence.
Public download links must be tested after deployment.
Retired or outdated resources must not be presented as current guidance.
